output.question: Where can I find Hermès' latest annual report?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Hermès’ latest annual report is its 2025 Universal Registration Document, which includes the annual financial report and is available on the [official Hermès Finance website](https://finance.hermes.com/en). You can [download the PDF directly](https://assets-finance.hermes.com/s3fs-public/node/pdf_file/2026-04/1777391712/260320_hermes_urd2025_en.pdf?VersionId=jE9NgndClrtsqa.kJW0uyG8NRg4SFCVU) or [read the digital version](https://hermes.fr.digital-report.net/en/report/5309).
caveats: The report’s publication date was not verified; 2025 identifies the reporting year.
missing_fields: Publication date for the report and quoted webpage passages.
